notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks 1.0 Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [b]our publisher Wired Productions and developer Caged Element have officially launched Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks on Steam today.[/b] Following an early access phase that saw over 250,000 players blast opponents, this high-octane combat racing game has had some tuning up and has sped into 1.0. 

Last week, Wired Productions revealed they had taken over publishing rights – [b]removing microtransactions entirely [/b]- and introducing fresh tracks, maps, game modes, and customization options. Assemble your crew of Grotz, Gitz, and Squigz – and battle in PVP and PVE lobbies! 

Visit the Warhammer site for more details and stay tuned for insights into the game's next explosive chapter, as Wired Productions continues its partnership with Caged Element, the original publisher of 2018’s acclaimed GRIP: Combat Racing. Embrace the chaos, ignite the battles, and experience the thrill of Speed Freeks like never before.

Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks is available now on Steam at a special discounted price of just $15.99, €15.99 and £12.79.  

[b]New content includes:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Player-hosted games: Create private or public lobbies with custom settings.  
[*] New Vehicle – Trukk: A havoc-wreaking ambush vehicle with a fearsome amount of firepower and rowdy orks in the back.  
[*] New Game Mode - Free Roam: Choose any map and create custom races around it, as well as practice driving skills and abilities.  
[*] New Maps: Da Dust Up and Da Gorge are Speed Freeks’ most dynamic and visually striking to date.  
[*] Ork Pit Bosses: Players can now unlock and customize Ork avatars to show off to teammates and enemies alike.  
[*] Alternative Weapons: Unlockable weapons expand the playstyles of each vehicle for new ways to master them.  
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078450/Warhammer_40000_Speed_Freeks/

notes.title: Free Filter Mode Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/920f110cedf0ec1183ab202ef21aef35b7ead4e8.jpg[/img]

Hello agents. 

Today Leviathan wants to share several important bits of news with you - please move your allocated 10 minutes of scheduled work break to a period of time that allows you to digest the announcements.

[h2]Filter Mode Update[/h2]

This update brings six unique visual filters you can toggle on the fly to change the mood, tone, and overall atmosphere of the game. Want to lean into that grainy retro horror feel? Go with 8MM Film or Old Film. Feeling surreal? Try Dreamcore or Fisheye. Craving something more subdued or haunting? Low Saturation and the new Nori-inspired Black and White filter will absolutely dial things up.

We loved messing around with these ourselves. It’s a great way to re-experience some of KARMA’s most intense moments with a whole new vibe.
Are you ready to step back into the darkness and uncover the secrets that lurk in the shadows of your mind?

[previewyoutube=mvyUs4oa-kU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]20% Discount[/h2]

To celebrate the new update, we've also put a special week long 20% discount on KARMA - starting RIGHT NOW and running until Monday 19th 6pm BST.

To mark the update (and because we're celebrating our birthday all month), we're offering 20% off for new players on Steam for a limited time. That brings the game down to just $19.99 / £15.99, and it’s the perfect excuse to finally check it out, or recommend it to a friend ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/

[h2]Steamdeck Verification[/h2]

Leviathan is also pleased to announce that KARMA has been awarded SteamDeck verified status! Agents who prefer to perform their investigations on SteamDeck can enjoy the full suite of features on the go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/aea7f3184ed8b8d7d72b3adf17e1fabc6903f223.jpg[/img]

The Filter Mode Update is not the only post launch feature being added to the game, we've been collecting your thoughts, suggestions and feedback since launch - so standby for further bug fixes and announcements in the near future.

Thanks for all your support. We can’t wait to hear what you think of the new filters. Tag us in your weirdest, wildest screenshots. Let’s see what kind of madness you can create!

Until next time.


Mother Is Watching

notes.title: The Month of Wired 17th Birthday Celebration!
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents. 

This May, the veil lifts. Secrets surface. And, as part of our publisher [b]Wired Productions[/b]'s massive [b]#MonthOfWired[/b] celebration, [b]KARMA: The Dark World[/b] steps deeper into the spotlight with a chilling new reason to return… or descend for the first time. 

From [b]May 12th to May 19th[/b], enter the Thought Bureau for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/]20% off[/url]. And while you’re in, prepare to see the world in a haunting new light – our brand new [b]Filter Mode[/b] is out now as a [i]free update[/i]. Perfect for players seeking a more noir, dreamlike, or cinematic journey through the twisted minds you dive into. 

[h2]KARMA: The Dark World – 20% Off May 12th![/h2] 

From psychological horror to bureaucratic mind control, KARMA takes you into the deepest corners of the human psyche. As Agent Daniel McGovern, you don’t just investigate — you invade. Use Thought Diving to uncover secrets, lies, and repressed memories in a world ruled by Leviathan. And now, experience it all with a stunning, shadow-drenched new visual mode. 

[h2]Other Games Within the Wired Family[/h2] 

Looking for more beyond the Bureau? Here’s what else is going down this May from the Wired family: 

[b]May 15th:[/b] Be one of the first to explore the horrors that lie in Beneath [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593230/Beneath/]Beneath[/url] with its public playtest. 

[b]May 15th:[/b]   
Check out Wired Productions… maybe you’ll discover their next game around 6am PST! 

[b]May 19th – 26th. 70% off[/b]: Uncover trauma and truth in... Martha Is Dead https://store.steampowered.com/app/515960/Martha_Is_Dead 

[b]May 20th:[/b] Design and run your own dream Hotel https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602000/Hotel_Architect 

[h2]Competitions[/h2] 

The Month of Wired brings not just discounts, but challenges. Face off for glory, prizes, and perhaps… redemption. Full details on Wired’s [url=https://gleam.io/WUpDd/win-a-limited-edition-custom-karma-the-dark-world-playstation-5-console]Promo Page[/url]. 

[h2]Observe. Uncover. Resist.[/h2] 

This is your time, Observer. Uncover the truth before it's erased — now 20% off, with a fresh new filter to change your view of it all. Available from May 12th. 

Check out the full sale: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33134072/sale/MonthOfWired

notes.title: KARMA: First Post Launch Patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/a7c9273e5c3bf40b1b64286b76b6421eccb1ccc8.jpg[/img]

Hello Agents.

What an amazing week it has been since the launch of KARMA: The Dark World! We have been absolutely blown away by the outpouring of love from the community. Your feedback has been invaluable. That enthusiasm and support fuel our passion to deliver even more exciting KARMA related content for you all.

We've got our first patch live right now - but before we get to the patch notes, a little bit of housekeeping for you all ;

[h3]Leviathan is in London![/h3] 

If you’re attending the London Games Festival, do come and say hello to the team, we’d love to meet you face-to-face and answer any questions you have about the game! 
We're on the bottom floor of the event opposite the presentation / talk stage - so look for the people with microphones then head into the shadows where the cool indie games are!

[h3]Share your Propaganda![/h3]
We've been lovingly sharing all your virtual photography with the team, as well as your fan art and streams,. This weekend we'll be showcasing some of our favourites here and on our socials - with game keys and codes for the artbook / soundtracks for the ones we like most! 

Make sure you have all your screenshots and creations on socials by Saturday, and remember to tag us @wiredp so we see them!

[h3]SteamDeck Support[/h3]
Don’t worry, Steamdeck fans: we are hard at work on verification support, which should be landing very soon, we will give an update once optimization is completed and we're ready to patch.

[h3]Launch Discount - one week remaining!
[/h3]And remember—you have one week left to take advantage of the Wired loyalty bonus. If you own any Wired game, simply visit the game page where you will find a bundle featuring KARMA. Add it to your library and receive up to 25% off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/ed9bb7a97fe6270db42fa9b63b9570846c9cbc6f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Corrected some Chinese subtitle typos.
[*] The ad video now correctly loops in the stamping room.
[*] Players can no longer accidentally get locked in some rooms.

notes.title: Early Reviews Roundup
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/41cdaf55dc82d564e18a1c511021e298ea6e790d.png[/img]

Good afternoon Agents 

As mentioned in yesterdays blog, a HUGE thank you to all of you for playing a part in making Pollards first game, Wired's biggest day one launch EVER. It means so so much to everyone involved.

We wanted to share a few of the reviews that have been put out in the wild to let people who may still be on the fence read the opinions of folks (and of course let people who've already played see how close they match up with their own!) But before that, a little housekeeping.

[h3]Upcoming patch[/h3]

Thanks to everyone who's been submitting bugs and issues, we've been replying, tracking, and finding workarounds as quickly as timezones allow. We are testing a patch that we hope to deploy at the start of the week to fix the immediate issues - and will keep you updated once it's live. In the meantime, We're updating the FAQ post with any current workarounds - so take a look there before new submissions, if it's not listed, feel free to submit!

[h3]Upcoming Features[/h3]

We teased it a bit yesterday, but we have some exciting feature updates to come that we'll be talking about soon. We're also taking note of ALL your suggestions in the steam forums and discussions (photo mode requests, key binding and the ability to skip cutscenes on a second playthrough for achievement hunters for example) and talking with the developers about what we can support and when. So PLEASE if you have an idea you think would be neat, or simply some feedback - don't be quiet about it - we see it all!

[h3]Please leave a review <3[/h3]

Whilst we're about to share some of the press thoughts and opinions here - which are important for people NOT aware of the game to learn about it - the reviews we really care about are YOURS, the good AND the bad.

Good reviews help the visibility of the game on Steam and help other gamers make better purchasing decisions with their hard earned cash. Bad reviews help us identify where improvements need to be made if you REALLY didn't vibe with the game - and to therefore make updates that are better for EVERYONE (all we ask is that if it is a negative review you are clear about what it was that didn't sit well with you so we can take steps to potentially rectify it for you :D )

Whilst we've made noise about this being our biggest launch ever - we are an indie publisher, and Pollard are an indie team launching their first game. Every review, every comment, every purchase, every wishlist, every trailer share, every screenshot, every stream is vital - they all add up to the visibility that makes a difference between someone else deciding to try the game or not, so for those that have done any of the above - thank you. For those that haven't, consider reviewing or sharing the game with your friends or favourite streamers - it is worth its weight in gold. 

[h3]What are the press saying? [/h3]

[b]Gamingbolt[/b]

[url=https://gamingbolt.com/karma-the-dark-world-review-what-are-memories]https://gamingbolt.com/karma-the-dark-world-review-what-are-memories[/url]

[i]Karma: The Dark World is ultimately an interesting experience. It’s the rare horror game where, while you’re not killing things and counting bullets by the buckets, you’re also not focused entirely on hiding... Pair that with some deliciously-thick atmosphere courtesy of excellent visuals and audio, as well as an intriguing story that’s being told in a compelling way, and you get a horror experience that is well worth your time.[/i]

[b]New York Times[/b]

[url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/28/arts/karma-dark-world-expelled-centum-review.html]https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/28/arts/karma-dark-world-expelled-centum-review.html[/url]
[i]
"The brilliant Karma: The Dark World is one of the most aggressively disturbing horror games released in some time. Throughout 12 hours of gameplay, Karma’s creators have taken many inspirations — including BioShock and “Severance” — to the next level with creepily surreal and bizarrely utopian set pieces. Here, the looping terror of Guillermo del Toro’s and Hideo Kojima’s P.T."[/i]

[b]PcGames.de[/b]

[url=https://www.pcgames.de/KARMA-The-Dark-World-Spiel-75140/Tests/Der-Psycho-Thriller-ist-mein-absoluter-Ueberraschungs-Hit-des-Jahres-1469093/]https://www.pcgames.de/KARMA-The-Dark-World-Spiel-75140/Tests/Der-Psycho-Thriller-ist-mein-absoluter-Ueberraschungs-Hit-des-Jahres-1469093/[/url]

[i]Karma is a story about philosophy, religion, and culture, about the essence of humanity. Finally, I'd like to leave you with something unrelated to the game itself, but something you should return to after experiencing it for yourself[/i]

[b]Game8[/b]

[url=https://game8.co/articles/reviews/karma-the-dark-world-review]https://game8.co/articles/reviews/karma-the-dark-world-review
[/url]
[i]if you appreciate games that challenge perception, twist reality, and leave you questioning everything, then KARMA: The Dark World is a journey worth taking.[/i]

[b]Gamingbible [/b]

[url=https://www.gamingbible.com/reviews/karma-the-dark-world-review-954650-20250326]https://www.gamingbible.com/reviews/karma-the-dark-world-review-954650-20250326[/url]

[i]KARMA: The Dark World is one hell of an enjoyable experience thanks to its stunning graphics, meaningful visuals, and gripping narrative. You will never know what’s coming next or where the story will take you but you are guaranteed to be in for a wild ride with a few jumps along the way.[/i]

There's plenty more out there for you to sink your teeth into, but for now we'll leave it there and get back to reading your own reviews - and we recommend everyone else does the same.

Don't forget you can save 10% on KARMA until April 10th - and we still have competitions running all the way til the end of the month (with even more to be announced that we'll share soon)

Thank you all once more for joining us in our Dark World, and have a wonderful weekend.

Mother Is Watching

notes.title: The Countdown Begins...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/371585a3aa850e49d098e13874fbac9b69cf4b9e.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

It's a huge week for everyone here - as we are 24 HOURS away from launch!

We've got some exciting things to share with you in this update - but before we get to it we also have a little bit of housekeeping.

[h3]Update your Game![/h3]

As mentioned yesterday we've been tracking frequently mentioned bugs and issues across your demo playtime. We have just pushed an update out that should fix all the serious offenders such as :

- HDR issues and blackscreens
- Crashing
- Video issues during playback scenes
- Many other smaller issues.

For those of you still rocking through the clerical lifestyle in our demo before launch, please make sure your build is fully updated for the smoothest experience, and once again thank you all for your reports.

On launch day we will have an FAQ available listing any ongoing and reported bugs, as well as any workarounds or solutions for folks to check before submitting anything new. We'll link to it on our launch day blog so eyes peeled!

[h3]WHEN CAN I PLAY?![/h3]

KARMA will be launching on March 27th at Mid-day GMT on Steam, and at midnight local time for those playing on PlayStation 5. We have this handy Leviathan approved global time map for you to see exactly when you'll be able to enrol as a ROAM agent this Thursday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/357c8981e44ec026210a4052057538dfaa568865.jpg[/img]

[h3][strike]S[/strike]Pay Less[/h3]
As the final piece of news in todays blog, we are pleased to announce that for two weeks starting on launch all PC Players will receive a 10% discount on KARMA, also applied to those on PlayStation with PsPlus. We also can announce our launch day bundle offerings. These come in 3 flavours, and the links will be live for you to view on launch day (we'll share them again don't worry) :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/538adc8cca512b1280acb5cd6eb1cb82adecfd03.png[/img]

1- The Deluxe Edition Bundle - All the KARMA content you could ever need, and then some.
- It includes the game
- The 138 page artbook (which is STUNNING)
- The 58 song soundtrack
- AND the 5 song EP featuring songs used during our EPIC trailer announcements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/2002dd1e98177e3fe7fb0645959d313ac08e8562.jpg[/img]

2 - The Wired Family Discount Bundles - as a thank you to all of our fans, if you own ANY of the Wired Productions library on Steam, you will be able to purchase a bundle with Karma included to 'complete the set' and save 15% on top of the 10% launch discount! Pretty good right?

This counts for ANY of our games, so check your library to see if you've already played any of our indie classics (Or heck, pick up [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/290100/Bulwark_Evolution_Falconeer_Chronicles/]Bulwark[/url] right now for the cost of a meal deal and get a fantastic City builder as well as your discount!)

If you're unsure, have a look at our Steam publisher page and check our range of games : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/WIRED]CLICK HERE TO SEE ALL OUR GAMES![/url]

3 - Finally, we are partnering up with two of our other Indie Publishing friends to celebrate both the love of indie gaming, and the disturbing worlds and tales that can be created within.

On launch day, you'll be able to pick up bundles of :
- KARMA and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373960/INDIKA/]INDIKA[/url]
- KARMA and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622910/Still_Wakes_the_Deep/]Still Wakes The Deep.[/url]

Unfamiliar with them? Here's a quick run down :

INDIKA is a third-person, story-driven game set in alternative Russia at the turn of the XIX century where religious visions clash with harsh reality. INDIKA tells the story of a young nun who sets off on a journey of self-discovery with the most unusual companion by her side, the devil himself - one for fans of games that break traditional conventions with mechanics and presentation interwoven expertly to tell a story.

Still Wakes The Deep places you in 1975 where disaster strikes the Beira D oil rig off the coast of Scotland. Navigate the collapsing rig to save your crew from an otherworldly horror on the edge of all logic and reality - one for fans of fantastic voice acting, supernatural horror, and anyone who fancies themselves handy with the leccy.

Right, that about wraps it up for today! However you decide to play KARMA, and whichever way you decide to pick it up - we thank you, and can't wait to hear your thoughts once the credits roll.

We'll speak again soon, and remember. The gates to Utopia are open to those who serve

notes.title: KARMA: The Dark World Launch Week!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/8aa4eb201068993beec95f7c202ce73960e0521b.png[/img]

Here we go agents, less than 3 days to go now until you step into the shoes of a ROAM agent!

[h3]Foreword[/h3]
Before we (brain) dive into what to expect this week - a quick note to those of you that have been playing the demo and reporting bugs, first of all, thank you! There will be a patch addressing what you've flagged up on the game ready for launch, so keep on reporting!

Pointing at the most notable  we've seen occurring :
- Black screens after calibration room settings - this is related to HDR, ensure it's disabled if you're having black screen crashes, this has been identified and will be fixed for launch.

[h3]What's happening this week?[/h3]
We've got LOTS to share with you before we launch, and whilst we don't want to spoil EVERYTHING ahead of our launch on Thursday, here's what you may want to keep an eye on during the week!

Tuesday 25th - Confirming full launch times per region and platform, as well as announcing some exciting bundles with other fantastic narrative games, as well as the loyalty discounts and where to buy.

Weds 26th - Some behind the scenes blogs from our friends at Unreal, Intel and more breaking down the technical specifics of the game and teaching you more about the world - as well as announcing the full achievement lists for the game.

Thurs 27th - LAUNCH DAY! Where a 24 hour Livestream hosted LIVE on steam will act as the hub for all the rest of our launch activities, including (but not limited to) :

- Live footage from a Leviathan clerks office, keep the employees company, help track strange goings on, and maybe win a couple of goodies.
- The launch of the full OST on all streaming services for you to enjoy
- Reviews and roundups / celebrations of the game!
- A whole host of creators scheduled to go live on every platform, in multiple regions - find someone to share the experience with if you'd rather watch the story unfold from behind a pillow!
- MANY competitions, including a VERY unique PlayStation 5, Handheld PC's, copies of the game, bundles with our partners and physical merch.
- And much much more.

Speaking of Physical merch... our Leviathan approved merch store quietly went live today, we'll be announcing it properly tomorrow socially - but you are all the MVP's and deserve first dibs before others start getting their hands on ROAM Agent Swag.

[url=https://shop.wiredproductions.com/collections/karma-the-dark-world]Merch Store[/url]

This is but the tip of the iceberg for what's happening this week, and we hope that you'll come and make lots of noise and celebrate the nervous excitement of launching a game with us. Keep your eyes peeled here for all updates and we'll make sure you don't miss a beat. We'll speak again soon, and remember. The gates to Utopia are open to those who serve

notes.title: KARMA: The Dark World Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/72909d991ea48704e348f12301e956a830a537bf.png[/img]

Hello agents.

We are now SIX days away from launch and our excitement is only growing! We have SO MUCH to share and celebrate over the next week, and hope you're ready to make March 27th the biggest, best launch ever!

That being said, we've been monitoring your feedback from the demo we launched this week, and have updated a few things to let you enjoy your trial employment at Leviathan before the big day even more.

[list]
    [*]Added 10 new languages!
    [*]Updated from Unreal Engine 5.1 to 5.4!
    [*]Updated the settings in the Settings menu, introducing a handful of new toggles.
    [*]Updated the upscaler tech to bring you Frame Generation, no matter which GPU you're using, alongside a host of other neat new features.
    [*]Many, [i]many[/i] minor bugfixes.
[/list]

We are watching. Be Productive.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/6a00c15a3553aaaabe1555b587ad9002ef7decd4.png[/img]

Hello agents, a new trailer has just been distributed during the DreadXP Horror Game Showcase for your enjoyment. You may choose to watch it during your mandated 3 minute break today - additional break time privilege is not being permitted for this.

[previewyoutube=gqBLsTzCekw;full][/previewyoutube]

Those of you who have played through the demo will recognise some the footage in here, but we' hope the more keen eyed of you will spot a couple of new additions, and wonder exactly what they could add up to.

We are all but Lost Lambs after all... sometimes a little guidance is all we need.

As an aside, there's a small patch being applied to the demo that fixes the intensity an application of head bobbing / movement in some scenes where they were not displaying correctly. Thanks to those of you who flagged them up to us!

We continuing to log your suggestions, bugs and feedback from the demo so please keep playing and let us know your thoughts.

You'll be hearing again from us very soon...

notes.title: Karma Next Fest Activities Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/6a00c15a3553aaaabe1555b587ad9002ef7decd4.png[/img]

Good evening agents.

First of all, thank you all for playing and sharing your feedback so far - from reviews to bug reports and suggestions, we are digesting it all and will use it to make the game even more polished before release. 

We've got a few updates around the demo itself, and some ongoing extra activities we have running at the moment that I want to make sure you're aware of! So without further ado :

[h2]Demo Patch 1[/h2]

On the launch of the demo there were some reports of folks not able to progress past the menu due to language settings on first booth being in a language they could not understand.

We identified the issue and this should now be resolved, apologies for the inconvenience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/8b54ed95c6809db71b6763c41f7f03af6acd987c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Karma Next Fest Bundle Competition[/h2]

To celebrate the demo launch, we've gathered some of our physical goodies including a shirt, a hand painted statue of your 'friend' from Shawns office, and a nifty vinyl coaster to give away! You can find entry details in the link below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/771c0077e0b7cc27beba774d18e4f32fe414506b.jpg[/img]

These aren't gonna be commercially available, so if you've found yourself feeling like a superfan already - now's the time to stake your claim!

[url=https://x.com/WiredP/status/1846212453362729198]Enter here![/url]

[h2]Photo Competition[/h2]

Not a fan of physical? Or simply have a set of skills of a more 'visual' nature? Well we are offering copies of the game away on launch to those who impress us with screenshots, edits, or fanart from the demo!

We've had some VERY cool entries so far, but there's plenty of time running on this - so dive in there and start paying attention to the finer details!

[url=https://x.com/KarmaDarkWorld/status/1846174183749046611]Entry details here[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/0bf3c1d2b1b1e41450b409e7751014dea99182bc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/46ec3a2dcae84ed6e75bb0f81c3f045363675d9f.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Leviathan Portal[/h2]

Looking to learn a little more about the world of Karma and perhaps root around in the Leviathan servers? Well someone has dug up the login details to that website that appeared last week - I'm pretty busy so can't dive in myself, but if you fancy yourself a bit of a problem solver maybe you'll haev more success.

user: Lamb00
pass: TGtU5re79L

[url=https://karmadarkworld.com/leviathan/]Leviathan Portal[/url]

Thank you once more everyone for playing - please keep leaving your feedback, and again - Wishlist, and share everything to make a devs day!

We'll be speaking to you very soon!

Join us : [url=https://discord.gg/karmadarkworld]https://discord.gg/karmadarkworld[/url]

Gary - Wired Productions
